settings.question: Does it work with Android phones?
settings.answer: No. The card works with Apple's Find My app, so you need an iPhone or iPad (iOS 14.5 or later). It can't be set up on Android.

settings.question: Is there a subscription or monthly fee?
settings.answer: None at all. You pay R599 once for two cards. Find My is built into your iPhone and free to use.

settings.question: How does it find my wallet when I'm far away?
settings.answer:
The card has no GPS or SIM. Instead it sends out a secure Bluetooth signal. When any Apple device on the Find My network passes nearby, it anonymously reports the card's location to you. It's end-to-end encrypted, so nobody else (including us and Apple) can see it.

It works best where there are people around, which in South Africa is most places. In very remote areas location updates are less frequent.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Order before 13:00 on a weekday and we dispatch the same day. Aramex delivers in 2–4 working days to main centres, and a day or two longer to outlying areas. Delivery is free and every parcel is tracked.

settings.question: Will it work inside a leather wallet?
settings.answer: Yes. Bluetooth passes through leather, fabric and plastic without a problem. Fully metal or aluminium wallets can weaken the signal, so the range may be shorter.

settings.question: What if I don't like it, or it stops working?
settings.answer: You have 30 days to return it for a full refund if you change your mind. If a card is faulty within 12 months, we'll repair or replace it, or refund you. See our returns & warranty page.

settings.question: Can someone use this to track me?
settings.answer: Find My has built-in protection against unwanted tracking. If an unknown tracker is travelling with someone, their iPhone alerts them, and many Android phones can detect unknown trackers too. Please only use it for your own belongings.

settings.question: How do I pay? Is it safe?
settings.answer: Checkout is handled by Yoco, a South African payment provider. Your card details are encrypted and go straight to Yoco; we never see or store them.
